spec.definitions:
def CertificateBytes := List Nat

def soundlyIssuable (artifacts : CertificateBytes) : Prop :=
  ∃ bytes, bytes ∈ artifacts

theorem L1_full :
    soundlyIssuable ([] : CertificateBytes) → False := by
  intro h
  rcases h with ⟨bytes, hbytes⟩
  simp at hbytes
spec.proof:
by
  intro h
  rcases h with ⟨bytes, hbytes⟩
  simp at hbytes
